notLoggedIn.title: Not Logged In
notLoggedIn.description: Login is required to access this route. Access token may be missing from headers.

notLoggedInError.title: Not Logged In
notLoggedInError.description: Login is required to access this route.

invalidClientToken.title: Invalid Token
invalidClientToken.message: Your token doesn't match the client token or is not a valid format.
invalidClientToken.description: The token provided in the headers does not match the client token or is not a valid format.

invalidUserPool.title: User Not Recognized
invalidUserPool.message: Your user token is not recognized as being a member of this system.
invalidUserPool.description: User might be valid but isn't a member of the cognito pool.

tokenExpired.title: Your Login Has Expired
tokenExpired.message: Your login as expired and you need to log in again.
tokenExpired.description: User's token haas expired and needs to be renewed.

loginTypeNotAllowed.title: Not Logged In
loginTypeNotAllowed.message: This login type is now allowed.
loginTypeNotAllowed.description: The login type has been disabled in configuration.

alreadyLoggedInDifferentType.title: Already Logged In
alreadyLoggedInDifferentType.message: You have already logged in via a different method.
alreadyLoggedInDifferentType.description: User is trying to login in via JWT after a session login or vice-versa.

unableToCreateEditUser.title: User Cannot Be Modified
unableToCreateEditUser.message: Your user account cannot be accessed at this time.
unableToCreateEditUser.description: User account creation or editing has failed.

internalServerError.title: Internal Server Error
internalServerError.message: The server has experienced an unexpected error.
internalServerError.description: General internal server error that doesn't match up to anything more specific.

invalidCredentials.title: Invalid Credentials
invalidCredentials.description: The code provided was not recognized as a valid authorization code.

notAuthorized.title: Not Authorized
notAuthorized.message: This user is not authorized to perform action {0}: {1}
notAuthorized.description: The user tried to perform an action they do not have permissions for.

requestInvalidFields.title: Request Invalid
requestInvalidFields.message: One or more of the requested parameters has invalid values.
requestInvalidFields.description: The request was not successful due to invalid values submitted int he request.
